name: TinyJev classifier
description: Local TinyJev-0.6B classifier: the sidecar downloads the model, loads it and answers one-forward-pass category questions; this plugin bridges the classification pipeline to it when native heuristics abstain.
author: Mail Triage

tinyjev_url.title: TinyJev service URL
tinyjev_url.description: Base URL of the TinyJev sidecar (see tinyjev/docker-compose.yml)

state_chars.title: Body characters in state
state_chars.description: How much of the message body goes into the model state

classify_timeout_ms.title: Classify HTTP timeout (ms)
classify_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for the sidecar call on the classify path

tools.name: tinyjev_status
tools.description: Report the TinyJev sidecar lifecycle: model download progress, load state, readiness and call count.

tools.name: tinyjev_classify
tools.description: Classify one text snippet with the local TinyJev model (test drive; does not touch the mailbox).

tools.name: tinyjev_load
tools.description: Ask the sidecar to start (or retry) the model download and load; no-op when already ready.

assistant.when_to_use: checking TinyJev model status or download progress, test-classifying a snippet, or nudging the sidecar to (re)load the model
